purpose: Correct four independently frozen exact-state labels to the accepted P07 uncertainty contract before any candidate execution; preserve all original history.

source_requirements.meaning: Losing the final supervisor write without a process_record leaves final status unknown; retain earlier actual start/logs and refuse a compatible success inspection.
Historical launch counts and final attempt/evidence state are separate. Positive retained evidence proves one; known counts do not stand in for final receipts.
Unretained failure evidence requires evidence_finalized=false/UNKNOWN; no successful outcome when failure evidence or cleanup is uncertain.
Visible failure preserves original evidence; uncertainty remains UNKNOWN; no retry or replacement.

corrections.applies_when: Supervisor loses final process record and raises after the earlier positive start receipt is durable.
corrections.reason: The supervisor loses its final record and raises without process_record after a retained positive start; final process/cleanup status is unproved. P07 design line 121 explicitly requires unknown final status.
corrections.unchanged_additional_assertion: No reconstructed success field; original raw receipt/exception stays unchanged; exact count one comes from the separate retained start.

corrections.applies_when: Inject failure writing/fsyncing reservation, preflight or intent before supervisor entry, one operation per subcase.
corrections.reason: A real write/file-fsync/directory-fsync failure prevents proof of durable reservation, preflight or intent/failure publication before launch. Persistence status is UNKNOWN; retained boundary proof still proves zero starts.
corrections.unchanged_additional_assertion: No child; retain any committed records; return evidence_finalized=false; never claim durable failure when persistence failed.

corrections.applies_when: After callback with positive PID, fail start-ledger write; preserve actual PID in the supervisor final receipt/outer capture.
corrections.reason: Start-ledger publication fails after an actual callback; retained callback/final receipt still proves one historical start, but failed evidence finalization remains UNKNOWN.
corrections.unchanged_additional_assertion: Category CHI-EVIDENCE even if supervisor wraps callback error; count stays one; cleanup and original cause/receipt retained.

corrections.applies_when: After a positive mocked start, fail process-outcome/postflight/failure write or directory fsync, separately.
corrections.reason: A real process-outcome/postflight/failure write or directory-fsync failure leaves finalization unproved after one retained start. Known count one does not prove evidence completion.
corrections.unchanged_additional_assertion: Preserve earlier committed artifacts and actual start; no second command; return failed/unknown evidence state.

state_surface.required: The returned unsuccessful observation/refusal state is UNKNOWN when final process/cleanup or publication durability is unproved. Where a newly retained failure/final sidecar represents this uncertainty, its state is UNKNOWN.
state_surface.preserve: Never rewrite an earlier durable intent/start/completed-command record, the original supervisor exception/process_record, or an uncertain writer temporary merely to make all historical records share the final overall state.
state_surface.counts: actual_counts and affected-command start_count_state keep the exact independently frozen values; UNKNOWN finalization does not turn known zero/one into an unknown historical start count.
state_surface.categories: CHI-PROCESS remains HI17-D; CHI-EVIDENCE remains HI18-A/B/C. No changed category, mutation, process budget, or success/approval boundary.

unchanged_obligations: Original freeze002 and supplement001 remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
All 109 original control IDs and five positives remain selected; this is no removal or waiver.
All actual OS/Node/ldd/checker starts in these controls remain zero.
No compatible success inspection, completion success, next command, retry, replacement, synthetic zero, invented cleanup or erased history.
Preserve original exception/object identity, raw bytes, intended publication bytes/hash, readback, committed artifacts and caller-captured failure wherever available.
No H0/H1/qualification/full routine/integration authorization is created.
basis: Independent reread of accepted P07 text and pre-execution test-design review. No candidate imports, compilation, tests, or observed execution results influenced this proposal.
approval_required: Director must explicitly approve this immutable proposal and its SHA-256 before affected execution; approval is recorded separately.
